# Flamingo Revolution

> Flamingo Revolution is a civic website for transparently collecting public concerns, ideas, and proposals in service of the protest and the public interest.

## Primary Language

Albanian (sq).

## Site

- Home: https://flamingorevolution.eu/
- Ideas and draft laws: https://flamingorevolution.eu/projektligje/
- Your ideas: https://flamingorevolution.eu/idete-tuaja/
- Contact: https://flamingorevolution.eu/kontakt/
- Sitemap: https://flamingorevolution.eu/sitemap-index.xml

## Crawling

Public pages and static documents may be crawled and indexed. Please respect the sitemap and avoid excessive request rates.
